Location: Mediterranean
Description:

Experienced Deckhand sought for a private and charter motor yacht over 85m, joining ASAP in the Mediterranean. This permanent role offers 60 days annual leave, increasing to 90 after one year. Responsibilities include tender driving and water-sports. Minimum 1-2 years yachting experience required, with strong deck skills and attention to detail. A Schengen visa or European passport is necessary. Additional skills in fishing, diving, or guest services are advantageous.
